constraints.description: A fresh embedded SurrealKV database receives every skill discovered from the built-in pack in the live registry.

validation.validation_method: Exact server-full embedded runtime integration test

constraints.description: Built-ins remain in persistence between runtime constructions and a second start leaves each built-in exactly once.

validation.validation_method: Three process boundaries: seed; reopen and load with seeding disabled; reopen and re-register with seeding enabled

constraints.description: Disabling default seeding omits all built-ins, while removing the enabled registration causes the availability assertion to fail and exact restoration makes it pass.

validation.validation_method: Exact disabled-seeding test plus branch-removal negative control and retained-diff hash comparison

constraints.description: Tier 0 and strict OpenSpec validation pass, Tier 2 remains unrun, persistence and scoped governance remain unchanged, and only the sanctioned GAP-05 line changes in SPECIFICATION.md.

validation.validation_method: Cargo check/clippy, OpenSpec strict validation, and scoped diff inspection

global_rules: Use the B3 OpenSpec delta and EXECUTION-CONTRACT.md as acceptance authority because the project has no .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md.
Report results only for server-full and transfer them to no other profile.
Do not run Tier 2 before all six readiness changes are implemented.
termination_conditions: The per-requirement verification record exists and includes the observed registration-removal negative control.
